name: timika-50k
description: Pooled chest radiograph dataset for the Timika TB severity score pipeline: 51,659 images across 7 public sources (Shenzhen, Montgomery, TBX11K, ChestX-Det, COVID-19 Radiography Database, BIMCV-CAAXR, SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax), each already carrying real localization (box, mask, or polygon), pseudolabeled with organ-region (6-zone lung) and partial disease-finding segmentation. Derived, not an original collection; see DATASHEET.md for the full 7-section datasheet and dataset/manifest.md for per-source provenance.
citeAs: Internal derived dataset, research-cxr-timika project. No standalone publication; cite the 7 component sources individually, see dataset/manifest.md.
license: https://schema.org/inapplicable -- no single license, inherits all 7 source licenses, restricted and no_redistribution, see DATASHEET.md Distribution section

distribution.name: images
distribution.description: 51,659 source radiographs, one subfolder per source, original filenames preserved. Not publicly downloadable, this FileSet describes the local layout, no containedIn archive exists since the dataset is internal-only, see DATASHEET.md Distribution section.

distribution.name: preprocessed_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Per-image provenance for the preprocessed/ layer: id, source, split, patient_id, study_id, original_relative_path, orig_height, orig_width, preprocessed_relative_path, view_position.

distribution.name: organ_region_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Per-image provenance for the organ_region label layer: method, confidence (model/failed/invalid), valid, empty, zones_present.

distribution.name: disease_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Per-(image, class) provenance for the disease label layer: method, confidence (real/high/low), positive, evidence.

recordSet.name: preprocessed_images
recordSet.description: One record per image in the preprocessed/ layer.

field.name: split
field.description: Native/folder-derived split token where a source defines one, "-" otherwise; NOT the train/val/test assignment, see splits_official.csv/splits_fair.csv for that.

field.name: patient_id
field.description: "-" where the source has no real per-patient identifier.

field.name: view_position
field.description: ap/pa/ll or "-"; real data for exactly caaxr (per-image) and montgomery (per-source constant), see DATASHEET.md.

recordSet.name: organ_region_labels
recordSet.description: One record per image, the organ_region label layer.

field.name: confidence
field.description: model | failed | invalid. Always model-derived, never real ground truth.

recordSet.name: disease_labels
recordSet.description: One record per (image, class) pair with a disease label file.

field.name: class
field.description: One of 7: cavitation, infiltrate, lymphadenopathy, pneumothorax, pleural_effusion, atelectasis, tb_lesion.

field.name: method
field.description: Provenance method, see DATASHEET.md Composition section for the full table.
